575.title: Pagination drops the last invoice on the final page
575.body:
## Problem

`pageBounds` returns an inclusive end.

## Scope

Return an exclusive end from `pageBounds`.

## Verification

- A unit test shows page 2 of 15 invoices ending at 15.

576.title: Credit notes are charged tax
576.body:
## Problem

A negative amount produced negative tax.

## Scope

Return 0 tax for a zero or negative amount.

## Verification

- A unit test shows a credit note owes no tax.

577.title: Explain the billing date in the docs
577.body:
## Problem

Customers ask when invoices are issued.

## Scope

Say in docs/billing.md that invoices are issued at 00:00 UTC.

## Verification

- The docs page states the time.

580.title: Fix pagination dropping the last invoice
580.body:
Returns an exclusive end from `pageBounds`.

Closes #575

## Verification

- Page 2 of 15 ends at 15: `tests/lib/pagination.test.ts` passed.

files.AGENTS.md:
# Ledger App agent guidance

Ledger App is the customer billing portal: invoices, plans, and account settings.

- The canonical tracker is GitHub issues in acme/ledger-app, configured in `.agents/managing-issues.json`.
- Run `pnpm test` before opening a pull request.
- Code under `app/billing/` and `db/migrations/` moves money or stored data. Treat it as sensitive.
- Customer-facing views live in `app/views/`.
